name: Alex Rivera
summary: Backend engineer with six years of experience building payment and order services in Go and Python. I own the checkout and refunds services for a mid-size online retailer, from design reviews to on-call.

bullets: Split the order monolith into four Go services on Kubernetes. Checkout p99 latency fell from 2.1 s to 1.2 s.
Rebuilt refunds as an idempotent workflow on PostgreSQL after duplicate refunds hit two holiday sales. Duplicates dropped to zero over the next two quarters.
Right-sized about 200 EC2 workloads with custom autoscaling policies, which cut the AWS bill by $340K a year.
Built the CI/CD pipeline in GitHub Actions and Argo CD for a 12-engineer team. Releases went from weekly to several a day.
Moved the notification service from cron batches to Kafka streams carrying about 2M events a day.
Wrote integration tests for the 20 most-used API endpoints. Customer-reported bugs fell 30% over the next two quarters.
